subject: AC not cooling
text: Resident: AC is running but blowing warm air, thermostat says 78 and climbing. I work from home so mornings are best. My dog is Biscuit, he's friendly but barks, I'll crate him if you tell me when you're coming.

subject: AC out again
text: Resident: AC stopped cooling AGAIN. Same as June. Its 84 inside. Please come in the morning if possible, Biscuit will be in his crate.

subject: Is the AC getting replaced?
text: Resident: Hi, AC is working again but this is the second time this summer. Is someone going to look at replacing the unit?

subject: Callback: HVAC vendor visit
text: Call summary: Called resident back about the HVAC vendor evaluation promised on 8/20 (a few days later than promised). Vendor visit set for 9/5, 9-11 AM. Resident confirmed Biscuit will be crated.

subject: HVAC vendor evaluation
text: Office-entered request: HVAC vendor to evaluate the system after two no-cool calls this summer.

subject: AC rattling
text: Resident: AC makes a loud rattling noise when it kicks on. Still cools. Is this the same unit that was supposed to be replaced? Mornings please.

subject: Slow kitchen drain
text: Resident: Kitchen sink drains really slow and there's a smell. ok to enter anytime.

subject: Smoke detector chirping
text: Resident: Smoke detector chirping in the bedroom. I work nights so please don't come before 11. And please don't call before 10, text is best.

subject: Bathroom fan loud
text: Resident: bathroom fan really loud, rattles. after 11am pls, I sleep days

subject: Move-in items
text: Resident: Moved in today. few things: bedroom 2 blind is broken, closet door off track, and freezer isn't cold yet (maybe it needs time?). Fine to enter, someone is home most days this week. Waffles (dog) is friendly.

subject: No heat
text: Resident: Heat not coming on. Thermostat set to 70, apartment is 61. Ok to enter.

subject: Toilet keeps running
text: Resident: Toilet keeps running after flush, have to jiggle the handle.

subject: Water heater popping
text: Resident: Water heater making a popping noise and the water isn't very hot.

subject: Dishwasher not draining
text: Resident: Dishwasher not draining, standing water at the bottom.

subject: Garbage disposal hums
text: Resident: Garbage disposal hums but won't spin.

subject: Washer leaking
text: Resident: Washer leaking from the bottom during spin, puddle on the floor.

subject: Bathroom outlet dead
text: Resident: Bathroom outlet stopped working. hairdryer tripped it maybe?

subject: Leak under kitchen sink
text: Resident: Leak under the kitchen sink, cabinet floor is soaked.

subject: Kitchen sink leaking again
text: Resident: kitchen sink leaking again, same spot as November.

subject: Replace sink cabinet floor
text: Office-entered request: replace water-damaged base cabinet floor under kitchen sink.

subject: Stain on bathroom ceiling
text: Resident: brown stain on the bathroom ceiling is getting bigger. Upstairs neighbor?

subject: When will the ceiling be fixed?
text: Call summary: Resident called asking when the bathroom ceiling will be repaired; it has been a month since the leak. Told resident the manager would call back by Friday with a date. Resident prefers calls weekdays 9 AM - 3 PM.

subject: Bathroom ceiling drywall repair
text: Office-entered request: drywall repair, bathroom ceiling (water damage from upstairs leak).

subject: Slow tub, gurgling sink
text: Resident: Tub drain is slow and the kitchen sink gurgles. After everything with the plumbing this year I'm worried.

subject: Kitchen sink leaking - 4th time
text: Resident: Kitchen sink leaking under the cabinet AGAIN. 4th time. Please send someone who can fix it for good.

subject: Ceiling fan wobbles
text: Resident: Bedroom ceiling fan wobbles a lot on high. OK to enter but my cat Pepper hides under the bed and will try to run out the front door, please keep it closed!

subject: Fridge leaking
text: Resident: Refrigerator is leaking water onto the floor. Please mind the door, Pepper is an escape artist

subject: Bathroom faucet dripping
text: Resident: bathroom sink faucet dripping constantly. same cat rules as always, thanks!

subject: Front door lock sticks
text: Resident: front door lock sticks, hard to turn the key

subject: Weak airflow
text: Resident: AC airflow is weak, filter looks dusty

subject: El horno no calienta
text: Resident: Hola, el horno no calienta. ¿Pueden venir mañana por la tarde?

subject: Hormigas en la cocina
text: Resident: Hay hormigas en la cocina, cerca del fregadero.

subject: Puerta del balcón trabada
text: Resident: La puerta del balcón no cierra bien, se queda trabada.

subject: Closet door off track
text: Resident: Closet bifold door came off the track.

subject: Roaches in kitchen
text: Resident: seeing roaches in the kitchen at night, small ones. under the stove and in the cabinets

subject: Pest follow-up
text: Office-entered request: pest control follow-up.

subject: Roaches back
text: Resident: Roaches are back. Is this coming from next door? I keep my kitchen clean.

subject: Bathroom fan not working
text: Resident: bathroom exhaust fan doesn't work

subject: Roaches again
text: Resident: few roaches again in the kitchen. not as bad as winter. pls treat the neighbors too like last time

subject: Furnace blowing cold
text: Resident: Furnace blowing cold air

subject: Dryer takes two cycles
text: Resident: Dryer takes 2 cycles to dry clothes

subject: Small repairs before move-out
text: Resident: Want to fix a couple things before I move out. hole in the bedroom wall from a TV mount and a cracked outlet cover.

subject: Dishwasher leaves dishes gritty
text: Resident: dishwasher leaving dishes dirty and gritty

subject: Dishwasher leaking at door
text: Resident: Dishwasher again, now leaking out the door.

subject: Dishwasher broken a third time
text: Resident: Dishwasher is broken AGAIN, third time. Can we just get a new one?

subject: After-hours lockout
text: Call summary: After-hours call at 11:40 PM. Resident locked out. On-call tech let resident in after checking ID. Explained the lockout fee in the lease.
